mapper.select: SELECT t.id,t.subject_id AS subjectId,t.user_id AS userId,t.title,t.content,t.status, t.reply_count AS replyCount,t.created_at AS createdAt,t.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.username AS username,u.nickname AS nickname,u.avatar_path AS avatarPath FROM topics t JOIN users u ON t.user_id=u.id WHERE t.subject_id=#{subjectId} AND t.status='OPEN' ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC

SELECT t.id,t.subject_id AS subjectId,t.user_id AS userId,t.title,t.content,t.status, t.reply_count AS replyCount,t.created_at AS createdAt,t.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.username AS username,u.nickname AS nickname,u.avatar_path AS avatarPath,u.signature AS signature FROM topics t JOIN users u ON t.user_id=u.id WHERE t.status='OPEN' ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC

SELECT t.id,t.subject_id AS subjectId,t.user_id AS userId,t.title,t.content,t.status, t.reply_count AS replyCount,t.created_at AS createdAt,t.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.username AS username,u.nickname AS nickname,u.avatar_path AS avatarPath,u.signature AS signature FROM topics t JOIN users u ON t.user_id=u.id JOIN subjects s ON t.subject_id=s.id WHERE (t.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR t.content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR s.cn_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR s.jp_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR s.alias LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND t.status='OPEN' ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE topics SET reply_count=reply_count+1, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
